vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +3 clean.
🍲 A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm eats with A person, maybe 40s — bowls side by side, talk low.
A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
"You haven't earned that yet," A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm says. (Trust too low.)
A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
💬 Thao is sitting with A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm, talking low. Not business. Just people. Company makes the road shorter.
👂 Overheard — A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "That snare line needs checking. Talk later, work now."
A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm was watching. Now they know Hickory Nuts too.
📋 A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm speaks 🇸🇦 Arabic. You share no language at all.

🛡️ Thao, the person in their 60s, with calloused knuckles, the person in their 40s, the person in their 60s, with freckles and Fawzia met them at the door — 5 put down. 📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Miguel just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Miguel just put down The Strike... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Terry just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
